scope: Independent audit of research method boundary, shared inputs, kernel width changes, source/control transformations, development selection and fresh confirmation scaffolding. This is not a new GPU experiment or an empirical accuracy-acceptance decision.
static_findings: Only current supplied train labels provide truth to reviewed learners. Released query arrays are allowed inputs; query labels remain with outer research scoring. This is unsandboxed research, not canonical isolation enforcement.
Teacher/student/optimizer/sampler/current-target buffers reset/refit for each timed member. Stored compile/graph owners retain buffers.

Widening first hidden layer to 1024 or 1536 with M=1 preserves exact column divisibility and bounded custom-combinator DP/workspace coverage; no static memory defect found. Compilation, resource and actual accuracy behavior still require retained execution outcomes.

Matrix L2 is coupled lambda/2 squared loss under Adam; hidden dropout and weight dropconnect are training-only. Controls remove added explicit interventions while preserving base Gaussian/tangent noise and reconstruction.
Probability ensembles sum normalized final HKNN/guarded class distributions with equal member weights, then argmax. They are not hard-label voting or raw-logit averaging.
Source entry correction: current 19 sources have _predict only, returning a tuple. An earlier statement that these files contained a broken classify wrapper was not supported and is corrected.

The extension and larger ensemble budgets were chosen after initial trends; they are adaptive exploration. Freeze selected source/prefix and predeclared comparison/control roles before confirmation on 11 fresh draws. No retuning on the fresh set.
Cold compile, input preparation, warmup, truth scoring and evidence serialization are outside the declared research algorithm clock; this does not establish canonical latency or energy.
infrastructure: Retain original zero-learner import/bootstrap failure and subsequent client-deserialization failure separately. The second attempt completed one remote input with unrecoverable numeric outcomes; do not claim zero prior learner execution.
Producer now returns/persists primitive JSON probabilities/metadata. No discarded-outcome replacement was authorized or launched by this auditor. Platform events must remain disclosed if observed.
interpretation: Accuracy remains conditional on this finite released MNIST procedure. Draw-level intervals do not prove a universal ceiling.
D2-D5 PR qualification and this D6 research are separate evidence sets. No official three-run D6 qualification follows from this screen or fresh 11 draw research confirmation.
Current research files lack an official label-returning wrapper; canonical qualification is an additional step on any resulting official candidate.
conclusion: The frozen eight-member L2 ensemble achieved 108666/110000 correct (98.7872727%; approximate draw-level t95 interval 98.6825872–98.8919582%), within 48.583700 seconds on every draw. It exceeded the matched control without added L2 by 149 labels, mean +0.1354545 percentage points (paired t95 interval +0.0992312 to +0.1716779), and the 450-step baseline by 618 labels. This independently confirms the predeclared 98.6% research target under the fixed-pool procedure. A later 98.7% band proposal has a 96-label observed margin, with uncertainty crossing that threshold. No official D6 qualification or universal accuracy ceiling is established.

poststudy_candidate_band.scope: Descriptive thresholds for later rule design, after seeing this frozen group; they do not replace the predeclared 98.6% confirmation target or establish independent canonical qualification.
